actions.name: RUN_TESTS
actions.description: runs the tests the selector names over the working tree as it stands, repeat times

goal.text: The project's test suite in work/ fails on some runs and passes on others. Find the root cause and fix it in the code, so that the whole suite (selector tests) passes on every one of twenty runs. Keep the behavior the docstrings document; do not skip, rerun or weaken a test.
